tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi man ngag yang gsang mthu bzlog nag po nyams su len tshul gyi yi ge bstan dgra'i srog dbugs len pa'i bshan pa nag po zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ 'dir dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi man ngag zab mo yang gsang mthu bzlog nag po nyams su len par 'dod pas/ mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus yar ngo dang mar ngo'i bcu bzhi gnyis po gang yang rung ba la/ lcags snod du gtor ma zur gsum pa/ zur rnams dang logs la chang bu zhib pa bdun dang / de'i mtha' mtheb kyu bdun gyis bskor te brgyan pa khrag gam ko ma sogs byugs pa'am/ ma byugs kyang rung ste/ gtor ma dang chang bu rnams mar dang sha'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa lag len ltar bsham pa nang mchod chu chang gang rung gis sbyangs la bzhag de nas rang nyid gtor ma de la kha phyogs pas 'dug la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed du/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lan gsum byas la/ de nas/ rang gi mdun du ma he'i gdan steng du/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed dbu gsum phyag drug pa/ /rtsa zhal ma he khros pa pheṃ sgra sgrog /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar mche gtsigs spyan gsum ldan/ /dang po'i phyag gnyis gri thod thugs khar 'dzin/ /g.yas kyi gnyis pas ḍa ma ru yi sgras/ /khro bo'i tshogs kyi dmag dpung sdud par byed/ /g.yon gyi gnyis pas bdud rtsis rang bzhin gyi/ /kha ṭwam̐ 'dzin zhing tha ma'i phyag gnyis kyis/ /glang lpags brgyangs shing drag po'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /de yi g.yas su las kyi gshin rje'i tshogs/ /ma he gyad glang rnga mo khyi lug dang / /lce spyang bong bu'i gdong can rnams gnas shing / /g.yon gyi phyogs su gshin rje bya rgod dang / /'ug pa bya rog ne tso khra dang khyung / /srin bya bzhad kyi gdong rnams 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /kun kyang phyag g.yas thod dbyug la sogs pa/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin zhing g.yon pa rnams/

/thod khrag zhags pas brel zhing re re'ang / /rang dang 'dra ba'i sprul pa 'bum gyis bskor/ /de yi phyi rol bstan bsrung tshogs rnams dang / /mthu rtsal ldan pa'i lha klu gza' phyogs skyong / /zhing skyong sde brgyad 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs/ /srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po kun gyis bskor/ /sprin phung 'thib dang bu yug 'tshub pa ltar/ /skad cig nyid la mngon sum gsal bar gyur/ /ces brjod cing bsam/ de nas spyan drang ba ni/ 'dir byon 'dir byon 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /khro bo gshin rje gshed po'i tshogs/ /'jam dpal khro bo mi zad pa/ /mthu rtsal drag po gshegs su gsol/ /dgra bgegs rdul du brlag par mdzod/ /ces pas spyan drangs la/ de nas/ khrag gi arghaṃ dbang lnga'i me tog dang / /tshil chen bdug spos zhun chen sgron me dang / /mkhris pa'i dri chab sha rus zhal zas dang / /rkang gling rol mo nam mkha' gang bas mchod/ /dur khrod rgyan gyis rab brgyan pa'i/ /zhe sdang gshin rje gshed po ni/ /dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la/ /ye shes khro rgyal rab brjid pa/ /dud kha mun chen khyod la bstod/ /ces mchod cing bstod/ de nas 'di ltar brjod cing bsgom par bya ste/ rang nyid 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /rin chen las grub ral pa'i gur khang nang / /rang gi bsrung bya thams cad gsal bar gyur/ /ral pa'i gur las gnam lcags 'khor lo dang / /mtshon cha me dpung grangs med rab 'phros pas/ /pha rol bsrung ba rbad 'dre ma lus pa/ /bsam ngan sbyor rtsub rbod stong byed pa po/ /rang la bzlog nas 'joms shing brlags par gyur/ /ces brjod cing bsam la/ rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i phyag g.yas lcags kyu dang / g.yon pa'i mdzub mo dngul gyi ma stan dang / mthe bong gser gyi sta grir bsam/ g.yas pa'i lcags kyus gnod byed bkug la/ g.yon gyi mthe bong gser gyi sta gris gtub par bsam la/

e sa bhyoḥbazlog rbad/ ci nus bzlas/ yang na rang nyid thub pa sku mdog nag /sa gnon mnyam gzhag mdzad par gsal bar gyur/ /ces brjod cing bsam la/ oṃ mu ne mu ne ma hā mu ne shākya mu ne ye swāhā/ gsum mam bdun bzlas la/ de nas gong du bshams pa'i gtor ma dang / rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed kyis bsgral ba'i gnod byed kyi sha khrag rnams dbyer med du bsam la/ 'bru gsum gyis byin brlabs nas lag pa g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang / g.yon pas phreng ba'i grangs bzung la/ na maḥs manta buddha nan/ a wa lo ki te sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐ phaṭ/ gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad ma ra ya phaṭ/ zhes drug cu rtsa bzhi'am/ nyi shu rtsa gcig gang rung bzlas la/ de'i bar gyi dmigs pa ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'khor dang bcas pas dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag la hab thob tu gsol bar bsam mo/ /de nas bden brdar brjod pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang / chos kyi༞ dge 'dun gyi༞ yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi༞ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi༞ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs pa la brten nas rnal 'byor ba bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la rbod stong rbad 'dre la sogs pa thams cad phyir bzlog par gyur cig ces dmod mo drag tu brjod cing thal mo brdab/ de nas ngag tu/ slar yang rang nyid 'jigs byed gsal/ /gshin rje gshed po'i lha tshogs rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag sogs nas/ bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /ces pa'i bar brjod la/ de nas yid kyis zor lam phye la gong gi gtor ma de nyid dug mtshon du bsam la/ rbod stong yo ba'i phyogs su 'phangs la/ dgra bgegs kyi rnam shes mar me lta bu thum bsad par bsam zhing / rdo rje 'jigs byed bsrung ma 'jig rten dregs pa'i dmag dang bcas pas dmigs yul gtan brlag tu btang zhing rnam shes chos dbyings su bsgral bar bsam la/

e sa bhyoḥbazlog rbadaḥmang du bzlas/ rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gsum pa'i ye shes pa rang la thim/ zhes brjod/ gzhan rnams mi dmigs pa'i ngang nas mnyam par gzhag go /'di lta bu'i zab mo'i man ngag 'di ni sngags pa phur thogs brgya dang 'gras kyang ya nga mi dgos pa'i man ngag ste/ bsam gtan nyal chog ces kyang bya/ bsad pa las kyi 'khor lo zhes kyang bya/ sngags pa phur thogs gsod pa'i lag cha zhes kyang bya/ yang gsang mthu bzlog nag po zhes kyang bya ste/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi man ngag zab mo kun gyi nang nas 'di kho na la bla ma gong ma rnams thugs rtsis su mdzad pa yin no/ /zhes pa 'di ni sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis bla ma gong ma'i snyan brgyud ji lta ba bzhin du dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi yang rtser sbyar ba 'di la chos bdag mkha' 'gros bzod par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa'i yi ge pa ni shab stod pa bkra shis don 'grub bo/ /da dung 'di la man ngag zhal shes cung zad yod pa slob ma snod ldan rnams kyis ngag las btsal bar bya'o/ /'di'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ la li ta badzra/ a mo gha badzra/ ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa'i dpal/ padma badzra/ bal po thugs rje chen po/ bla ma rā lo tsā ba rdo rje grags/ rā chos rab/ rā ye shesaseng ge rā 'bum seng / rong pa dga' lo/ bla ma shes rab seng ge mnyam med grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal pa/ chos rje dge legs dpal bzang / sngags 'chang a nanda ma ti bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa chos rin chen/ rje dpon brtson 'grus rgya mtsho/ bla ma blo gros dpal ldan/ 'dren mchog sangs rgyas mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgya mtsho/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor nam mkha' rgya mtsho/ chos rje lo phu gdan sa pa kun dga' dpal 'byor/

sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams rnams so/ /sbas pa'i rnal 'byor nam mkha' rgya mtsho/ chos rje bzang po rgyal mtshan pa dang / rdo rje 'dzin pa sangs rgyas 'od zer gnyis las kyang gsan gsungs/ yang brgyud pa lugs gcig la/ rā ye shes seng ge nas/ rā dharmā seng ge rā dkon mchog seng ge rā dbon shes rab rgyal mtshan/ chos rje dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus/ bla ma brtson 'grus byang chub/ sems dpa' chen po bsod nams yon tan/ chos rje dge legs bzang po yan gong dang 'dra'o/ /smras pa/ sems dpa' chen po spyan snga rin chen las/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed dbang dang las gshin gyi/ /rjes gnang gzhan yang zab khrid ma lus pa/ /mtshan ltas bzang po dang bcas dges bzhin gnang / /rgyud kyi rgyal po rtog bdun rtog pa gsum/ /'grel pa man ngag yig rnying phal cher dang / /mkhas grub chos rin gyis mdzad rnam bshad kyi/ /lung rnams chos rje lo phu ba las nos/ /de phyir phyi ltar sngags 'chang gos dkar 'dzin/ /nang ltar dpal ldan gshin rje ma he'i gdong / /snang srid 'jam dpal khro bo'i rol pa che/ /a la la ho 'di yang bla ma'i drin/ /zhes kyang shugs 'byung du smras so/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༄༅/ /'jigs byed kyi yi ge bzhi pa'i gsang bzlog bzhugs/ bla ma dang dpal 'jigs byed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma bal po thugs rje chen po la/ rwa lo tsā rdo rje grags kyis rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gdams pa ma lus pa zhus pa'i mthar gser srang brgya 'bul bar zhal gyis bzhes nas gnang pa'i man ngag rdo rje 'jigs byed drag po khros pa'i yi ge bzhi pa'i gsang bzlog drag po mngon spyod kyi las gsang ba'i man ngag rmad du byung ba/ yang gsang mthu bzlog nag po 'di bsgom par 'dod pas dus nyi ma nub la/ kha nub tu phyogs te/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/

spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yas pa thugs kha na ral gri me 'bar ba bsnams pa/ g.yon pa'i mtheb chen gser gyi sta gri chen po rno ba'i ngar dang ldan pa/ mdzub mo dngul gyi stan pa 'khrigs pa rgya che ba/ ral pa nag po ban bun gyi phyed kyis lus khebs pa/ phyed nam mkha' la yeng yeng 'phyo ba/ ral pa'i phyi la bskal pa'i me dmar 'ur 'ur 'phro bas dgra bgegs gnod byed thams cad bsreg pa/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ zhabs gnyis bgrad pa/ shin tu che ba ri'i rgyal po tsam du bsgom pa'i thugs kar hūm̐ nag po chen po gcig bsgom/ de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ 'od zer rnams khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas lcags kyu dang / g.yon zhags pa thogs pa grangs med par gyur nas/ de rnams kyis bdag la gnod pa'i ban bon dang / dgra bgegs dang / gnod byed kyi chos skyong rnams bkug nas lcags kyus snying kha nas bzung / zhags pas ske nas bsdams nas dngul gyi stan pa'i khar khyer yong ba dang / gser gyi sta gris sha rdzogs rus rdzogs dmar 'dag 'dag dum bur gtub par bsam/ rang gis bla ma dang / grogs po/ gnyen tshan/ 'khor g.yog la sogs bsrung na/ rang gi ral pas khyab pa ral pa dang lus po'i bar du bsgoms pas bsrung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po la sogs pa'i 'dre gdon tshabs chen gnod na'ang dmigs pas dgug pa dum bur gtub par bsam mo/ /sngags ni/ e sa bhyoḥbazlog ces pa 'di lag pa g.yas pas phreng ba phyir la 'phul zhing bgrang / sngags nag mthu can dang 'gras pa'am/ nyam nga ba yod na stong ngam/ lnga brgya tsam re bzlas/ rang bsrung ba tsam la brgya'am/ nyi shu rtsa re'am/ dran pa tsam gyis chog zla ba mar ngo'i nyi shu dgu la ma chag par bya'o/ /thun 'jog khar gshegs bsdu dang / dmigs pa la sogs pa bsgom mi dgos/ 'di rwa'i bsam gtan nyal chog ma zhes kyang bya/ sngags pa gsod pa'i lag cha yin pas mi nag pa'i lag tu ma shor ba gal che/

phreng thogs yongs la gnod pas shin tu gsang bar bya'o/ /'di chig brgyud las med pas spel ba'i dus su mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i tshogs 'khor dang / bla ma la gser gyi maṇḍal phul la zhu zhing / khyad par du'ang rten 'brel gyi che ba go khrab bam ral gri'am/ tha ma yang mtshon gyi rtse ma chag pa gcig 'bul/ 'di bla ma'i ngag las bzung ba ma gtogs pa yi ger mi 'bri bka' rgyas btab/ cis kyang nga la 'di 'dra yod ces mi smra bar gsang ngo / /rgya rgya rgya rgya// ༈ rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gsum pa'i yang gsang mthu bzlog nag po bzhugs/ skyabs sems sngon du song nas/ mdun du ma hi steng du rdo rje 'jigs byed sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa zhal ma he shin tu khros pa'i zhal can/ pheṃ sgra sgrog pa/ g.yas zhal dkar ba/ g.yon zhal dmar ba/ zhal bgrad mche gtsigs/ spyan gsum bgrad/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis gri thod thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yas gnyis pas ḍa ma ru 'khrol bas khro bo'i dmag dpung sdud par byed pa/ g.yon gnyis pas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyi kha ṭwam̐ ga 'dzin pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis glang lpags brgyangs te 'dzin pa/ ling ga dmar po gyen du bsgrengs pa/ mi mgo skam po'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa'i do shal 'phyang ba/ de'i g.yas su las kyi gshin rje ma he'i gdong can/ gyad kyi gdong can/ glang gi gdong can/ rnga mo'i༞ khyi'i༞ lug gi༞ ce spyang gi༞ bong bu'i gdong can rnams g.yas thod dbyug dang mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin pa/ g.yon zhags pa dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ rang 'dra'i sprul pa 'bum gyis bskor ba/ g.yon du gshin rje bya rgod kyi gdong can/ 'ug pa/ bya rog ne tso/ khra/ khyung chen/ srin bya/ bzhad kyi gdong can rnams mtshon cha 'dzin cing rang 'dra'i sprul pa 'bum gyis bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol tu dur khrod/ bsrung ma mthu rtsal can rnams dang / lha chen brgyad/ phyogs skyong rnams dang /

klu chen/ gza' chen/ zhing skyong ba rnams dang / 'jig rten gyi sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs/ yi dwags mthu chen gyi tshogs dang / srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs kyi bskor bar bsam/ spyan 'dren pa ni/ 'dir byon 'dir byon 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /khro bo gshin rje gshed po'i tshogs/ /'jam dpal khro bo mi zad pa/ /mthu rtsal drag po gshegs su gsol/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i khrag gi arghaṃ/ dbang po lnga'i me tog tshil chen gyi dud pa/ zhun chen gyi sgron me/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/ sha rus kyi zhal zas/ rkang gling gi rol mo rnams kyis mchod par bsam/ dur khrod rgyan gyis rab brgyan pa'i/ /zhe sdang gshin rje gshed po ni/ /dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la/ /ye shes khro rgyal rab brjid sku/ /dud kha mun 'joms khyod la bstod/ /de'i gtor bshom ni/ gtor ma zur gsum pa/ zur rnams dang logs la chang bu bdun gshibs pa/ mtheb kyu bdun gyis bskor ba/ khrag gam ko ma byugs pa'am/ dkar gtor byas kyang rung / gtor ma rgyan dang bcas pa nang mchod chu chang gang rung gis sbyong / ༈ rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ rin po che las grub pa'i ral pa'i gur khang dang bcas/ ral pa'i gur khang las gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo mtshon cha me dpung dang bcas pa 'phro ba/ pha rol rnams kyi bsrung ma rbad 'dre dang bcas pas kho rang 'joms par byed pa/ ral pa'i gur khang du bsrung bya rnams sba bar bsam/ phyag g.yas lcags kyu dang / g.yon pa'i mdzub mo dngul gyi mas stan dang / mthe bong gser gyi satwa grir bsam/ g.yas pa'i lcags kyus gnod byed bkug la/ g.yon gyi mthe bong gser gyi satwa gris gtub par bsam la/ e sa bhyoḥbazlog rbad gang mang bzlas/ yang rang nyid thub pa nag po sa gnon dang mnyam bzhag mdzad par bsgom la/ oṃ mu ne mu ne ma hā mu ne shākya mu ne ye swāhā/ g.yas mchod sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang /

g.yon grangs bzung la mdun bskyed kyi mgron la dmigs te/ na maḥs manta buddha nan/ a wa lo ki te sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐ phaṭ/ gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad mā ra ya phaṭ/ zhal gsum pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag hab thob la gsol bar bsam/ drug cu rtsa bzhi'am/ nyi shu rtsa gcig skabs sbyar bzlas/ bden brdar brjod pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang / chos kyi༞ dge 'dun༞ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi༞ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi༞ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs pa la brten nas rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la rbod stong rbad 'dre la sogs pa thams cad phyir la bzlog par gyur cig ces dmod mo drag tu brjod cing thal mo brdabs/ de nas yang rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis par bsam la/ gshin rje gshed po'i lha tshogs rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes las/ /zhes sogs dang / dmigs pas zor lam phye la gtor ma dug mtshon du bsgyur la dgra bgegs kyi rnam shes mar me lta bu bsad par bsam/ gtor ma 'phangs/ e sa bhyoḥbazlog rbadaḥ zhal gsum pa'i ye shes pa rang la bsdu/ mi dmigs pa'i ngang la bzhag go /yang gsang mthu bzlog nag po ni/ /phyi rabs bstan pa'i don du sbyar/ maṅga laṃ// ༄༅/ /yi ge bzhi pa'i bzlog pa bzhugs/ bla ma rdo rje 'jigs byed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma bal po thugs rje chen po la/ rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyis zhus te/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gdams pa ma lus pa zhus pa'i mthar gser srang brgya 'bul bar dam bcas nas gnang ba'i man ngag rdo rje 'jigs byed drag po khros pa yi ge bzhi pa'i gsang bzlog drag po mngon spyod kyi las gsang pa'i man ngag rmad du byung ba/ yang gsang mthu bzlog 'di bsgom par 'dod pas/ nyi ma nub kha ru kha nub tu phyogs te/

stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yas kyis thugs khar ral gri me 'bar ba bsnams pa/ g.yon pa'i mthe bong gser gyi satwa gri chen po rno ba'i ngar dang ldan pa/ mdzub mo dngul gyi stan pa 'khrigs shing rgya che ba/ ral pa nag po ban bun gyis lus phyed khebs pa/ phyed nam mkha' la yeng yeng 'phyo ba/ ral pa'i phyi la me dmar 'ur ru ru 'phro bas dgra bgegs gnod byed thams cad bsregs pa/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa/ ljags 'dril pa/ zhabs gnyis bgrad pa/ shin tu che ba ri rab tsam bsgoms pa'i thugs khar hūm̐ nag po chen po gcig bsgom/ de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas 'od zer rnams khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas lcags kyu dang / g.yon zhags pa thogs pa grangs med pa sprul nas/ de rnams kyis bdag la gnod pa'i ban bon dgra bgegs gnod byed kyi tshogs rnams bkug nas/ lcags kyus snying kha nas bzung / zhags pas ske nas bsdams nas dngul gyi stan pa'i khar khyer yong ba dang / gser gyi sta gris dmar 'dag 'dag la sha rdzogs rus rdzogs su dum bur gtub par bsam/ rang gi bla ma/ grogs po/ nye tshan 'khor g.yog la sogs pa bsrung na rang gi ral pas lus khebs pa'i bar du bsgoms pas bsrung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po la sogs pa'i 'dre chen gnod na'ang dmigs pas bkug la dum bur gtub par bsam mo/ /sngags ni/ e sa bhyoḥbazlog ces pa/ phreng ba lag pa g.yas pas 'phul la bgrangs/ sngags nag mthu can dang 'gras pa'am/ nyam nga ba yod na stong ngam brgya rtsa re bzlas/ rang bsrung ba tsam la brgya'am/ nyi shu rtsa re'am dran pas kyang chog zla ba mar ngo'i nyer dgu la ma chag par bya'o/ /thun 'jog khar gshegs bsdu dang dmigs pa sogs mi dgos/ rwa lo tsā ba'i bsam gtan nyal chog ces kyang bya/ sngags pa gsod pa'i lag cha yin pas mi gzhan gyi lag tu ma shor ba gal che/

phreng thogs yongs la gnod pas shin tu gsang ba gal che/ 'di'i lung gi brgyud pa med pas spel pa'i dus su mkha' 'gro la tshogs 'khor dang / bla ma la maṇḍal phul la zhu/ bla ma'i ngag las bzung ba ma gtogs yi ger mi 'bri ba'i bka' rgya yod ces gsang bar bya'o/ /'di'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ la li ta badzra/ a mo gha badzra/ ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa/ padma badzra/ bal po thugs rje chen po/ rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags/ rwa chos rab/ rwa 'bum seng / rwa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ bla ma sngags dkar ba dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ bla ma khro chen pa/ gzhon nu skyabs/ sprul sku shes rab bzang po/ rgyal po dpal/ yang na/ shes rab rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge shes rab bzang po/ rgyal po dpal/ rgyal mtshan dpal lo// ༈ //yi ge bzhi pa'i bsrung bzlog bshad gsum bzhugs/ bdag nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal du bsgom/ dbu skra phyed kyis stong nyis stong chen po khebs pa/ phyed thur du 'phyang ba/ sku mdog nag po sol ba'i sdong po bcag pa'i 'phro lta bu phyag g.yas na ral gri 'phyar ba/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dang thod khrag bsnams par bsgom/ ral pa'i gseb tu bdag dang bsrung bya rnams bsgom/ de dag gi phyi rol na yul 'khor dang nor la sogs pa bskyed/ de nas sngags 'di rgyun du bgrang e sa bhyoḥbasrung / e sa bhyoḥbazlog e sa bhyoḥrbadaḥ bsrung ba/ bzlog pa/ bsad pa gsum yin/ mthe bong gser gyi sta gri gcig tu bsgom/ mdzub mo dngul gyi stan pa gcig tu bsgom/ byad ma'i ske phrul phrul gyis gtub par bsgom/ phreng ba phyir 'phul bzlog nyi ma rgas kha dang bskrad do/ /rang skad cig gi dran rdzogs la/ 'jam dpal khros pa sku mdog nag po phyag mtshan gzhung dang 'dra/ rin po che sna bdun las grub pa'i ral pa sku lus kyi mdun rgyab gur phub pa ltar yod pa las mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi 'od zer 'phros pa las/

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang rgyud sde bzhi/ yi dam gyi lha tshogs la phog pas/ de rnams kyi phyag mtshan sna tshogs pa 'od zer gyi tshul du byung nas/ rang gi ral pa'i mtshon cha'i gur la thim pas/ mtshon cha gur khang gi spu khros pa ltar gzengs nas mtshon cha'i 'od zer 'phros pas/ gnod byed rnams tshar bcad de gtub par bsam/ sngags gong ma ni bsrung sngags/ bar ma ni bzlog sngags/ 'og ma ni bsad sngags so/ /nyi ma nub la khad dang bskrad la thal mo brdab/ gnod byed nyi ma rgas pa dang tshe mnyam du song bar bsam mo/ /maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi man ngag yang gsang mthu bzlog nag po nyams su len tshul gyi yi ge PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
